shortDescription: Gathers facts about a Splunk installation

options.name: app_dirs
options.description: List of paths (relative to I($SPLUNK_HOME/etc)). An absolute path can be provided to check a specific path. An empty list C([]) can be provided to disable app inventory collection.

options.name: ksconf
options.description: Set the level of ksconf detail to collect. Use I(skip) to disable all ksconf related facts, I(short) to collect basic information, and I(detail) to show information about the available subcommands.

options.name: splunk_home
options.description: Path to Splunk installation path. If not provided, this module will check the $SPLUNK_HOME environment variable and then several commonly used install paths. Can also be set to I(skip) to disable normal Splunk information collection.  Useful in Splunk-detached cases, like app dir scans.
